title: thumbnail-handoff
blurb: Thumbnail workers disappear on spurious wakeups and remain parked because queue closure wakes only one consumer.
brief:
Parser threads hand thumbnail tasks to workers through a condition-backed queue. Thread evidence shows consumers parked after shutdown, while rare runs lose a worker after a wakeup with no task.

Start with `diagnostics/threads.txt`, then inspect `handoff/queue.py`. The tests coordinate threads with events rather than timing sleeps.

**Your job:** make waiting predicate-based, drain accepted tasks exactly once, and broadcast terminal state so shutdown joins cleanly.
